followup_explanation:
I picked Petrel-235B because your request is a creative marketing task — writing a promotional Twitter post — and that maps directly to the "Creative Generation" capability dimension in the model docs.

On that metric, Petrel-235B scores 84.7 versus Avocet-235B's 78.8. That's a ~6-point gap, well above the 2.0-point run-to-run variance threshold, so it's a meaningful difference rather than a tie. Petrel also leads on the broader benchmarks (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6), which tend to track quality on open-ended generation and instruction-following — both relevant for nailing the tone and constraints of a good social post.

The content itself is completely benign, so the models' safety/moderation behavioral notes (where they're roughly equivalent anyway) didn't factor in. With everything else — cost, latency, context window — identical across the fleet, it came down to which model is simply better at the creative work, and that's Petrel.
